test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : PKN :: TOR : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : PKN :: TOR : %

Option 1) # = KPJ, % = YOJ → KPJ : PKN :: TOR : YOJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d2797457f0504d0af336160012b46e9d47c32fe4ab44474e4ef844aa028681c.png] 

Option 2) # = KFI, % = YTW → KFI : PKN :: TOR : YTW

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/199f8da393bf52cb966dcd1a2a3e9e44b1ab0234458f5120c046419a46b6c055.png] 

Option 3) # = KFL, % = YPG → KFL : PKN :: TOR : YPG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3668763fe73672c090af6b84c9ddcbf192701ceaa9a6d18405406620811213d.png] 

Option 4) # = LJY, % = YVX → LJY : PKN :: TOR : YVW

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e73c4656adf893cc799734b1932d1df6f1eb26fa07f42e9b3d3b73013590f9b.png] 

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
